status: Conditional support-envelope redesign and separate ideal straight-beam stress; no engineered support pass

support.scope: Stepped envelopes and centre crosshead are authored geometry; connection, step transition, restraint, actual member stiffness and forces are unproved.

idealStraightControl.section: RHS 80 x 50 x 5; 80 vertical; perfect clamp
idealStraightControl.scope: Single straight cantilever with 300 kg static point load at free end. It is not a structural calculation for the stepped, multi-beam, weathered or dynamically loaded assembly.

limits: An unstepped 100-deep member overlaps the inner midrail by 6 mm; an unstepped 80-deep member clears that rail by 14 but penetrates the collector underside by 50.
The nominal stepped rear sits 18 below a 2 mm collector underside; real fittings, welds, fixing clips, movement and hydraulic enclosure can remove that clearance.
Four beam axes leave 51 nominal at the nearest 48 post; the central crosshead and actual bracing must clear the post, ports, workers, chutes, door and full load.

All four rear beams cross the overflow shaft y5150–5350 at +6160…+6240. They need sealed wall penetrations, retained structural continuity and a water-obstruction/splash test; the east beam is only 5 from the adjacent chute in plan and its top only 15 below that chute bottom.

The ideal straight-beam control cannot qualify a stepped member, crosshead, plate, steel grade, joint, scaffold, anchor, water load, manufacturing, deflection, uplift or human work. The 300 kg is a chosen stress, not a measured payload.
No water, weather, blocked shaft, safe access, rescue or physical acceptance is established.
